operators.sql:
-- The strategy's four objectives and their targets, as page 5 of the PDF states them: one
-- row per target, in the strategy's words (footnote marks dropped).
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT i, trim(l) AS l
  FROM (SELECT unnest(string_split(text, chr(10))) AS l, generate_subscripts(string_split(text, chr(10)), 1) AS i FROM input_0 WHERE page = 5)
),
heads AS (
  SELECT i, l, CASE l
    WHEN 'Strengthening participation and developing human-centred services' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Reducing cancer burden through prevention and early detection' THEN 2
    WHEN 'Ensuring equal and effective cancer care' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Staying at the forefront in a changing environment' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Equality' THEN 5 END AS g
  FROM lines
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT i, l, g IS NOT NULL AS is_head,
    max(g) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS goal,
    sum(CASE WHEN starts_with(l, '•') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS bullet
  FROM heads
),
titles AS (SELECT g AS goal, l AS title FROM heads WHERE g BETWEEN 1 AND 4),
grouped AS (
  SELECT goal, bullet, string_agg(l, ' ' ORDER BY i) AS target
  FROM tagged WHERE goal BETWEEN 1 AND 4 AND NOT is_head AND bullet > 0
  GROUP BY goal, bullet
)
SELECT g.goal, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g.goal ORDER BY g.bullet) AS n, t.title,
  regexp_replace(regexp_replace(g.target, '^•\s*', ''), '\*+$', '') AS target
FROM grouped g JOIN titles t USING (goal)
ORDER BY g.goal, n

-- Tays Cancer Centre's Net Promoter Score as published (autumn 2023), against the strategy's target NPS above 80
SELECT unit, period, nps, responses, 80 AS target_nps FROM input_0

-- County indicator panel: every Sotkanet indicator the goal dashboards use, one row per indicator, region (23 wellbeing services counties and the whole country) and year.
-- better: 1 = higher is better, -1 = lower is better, 0 = neither (context). goal: G1-G4 = the strategy's objectives, EQ = the cross-cutting equality goal.
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_0 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_1 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_2 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_3 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_4 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_5 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_6 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_7 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_8 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_9 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_10 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_11 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_12 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_13 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_14 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_15 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_16 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_17 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_18 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_19 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_20 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_21 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_22 UNION ALL
  SELECT indicator, region, year, value FROM input_23
),
meta(indicator, ord, key, label, unit, better, goal) AS (VALUES
  (4934, 1, 'enough_time', 'Sufficient time at last health visit', '%', 1, 'G1'),
  (4909, 2, 'unmet_doctor', 'Insufficient doctor services', '%', -1, 'G1'),
  (5385, 3, 'fees_rii', 'Fees limit care, education RII', 'RII', -1, 'G1'),
  (3253, 4, 'discrim_low_edu', 'Discrimination in care, low education', '%', -1, 'G1'),
  (3255, 5, 'discrim_high_edu', 'Discrimination in care, high education', '%', -1, 'G1'),
  (3621, 6, 'screen_breast', 'Breast screening participation', '%', 1, 'G2'),
  (3620, 7, 'screen_cervical', 'Cervical screening participation', '%', 1, 'G2'),
  (6103, 8, 'screen_colorectal', 'Colorectal screening participation', '%', 1, 'G2'),
  (4404, 9, 'smokers', 'Daily smokers', '%', -1, 'G2'),
  (4408, 10, 'smokers_low_edu', 'Daily smokers, low education', '%', -1, 'G2'),
  (4410, 11, 'smokers_high_edu', 'Daily smokers, high education', '%', -1, 'G2'),
  (4459, 12, 'obesity', 'Obesity (BMI 30+)', '%', -1, 'G2'),
  (5527, 13, 'inactive', 'Insufficient physical activity', '%', -1, 'G2'),
  (5643, 14, 'cancer_index', 'Cancer morbidity index (FI = 100)', 'index', -1, 'G2'),
  (3625, 15, 'surv_breast', 'Breast cancer 5-year survival', '%', 1, 'G3'),
  (3626, 16, 'surv_cervical', 'Cervical cancer 5-year survival', '%', 1, 'G3'),
  (3627, 17, 'surv_bowel', 'Bowel cancer 5-year survival', '%', 1, 'G3'),
  (5033, 18, 'late_referrals', 'Referrals processed after 21 days', '%', -1, 'G3'),
  (5093, 19, 'cancer_medicine', 'Cancer medicine refunds (age-std.)', '%', 0, 'G3'),
  (2475, 20, 'oncology_visits', 'Oncology and radiotherapy visits', 'visits', 0, 'G4'),
  (180, 21, 'education', 'Educational level', 'index', 1, 'EQ'),
  (181, 22, 'unemployment', 'Unemployment', '%', -1, 'EQ'),
  (3126, 23, 'gini', 'Income inequality (Gini)', 'index', -1, 'EQ'),
  (2456, 24, 'occ_health', 'Occupational health visits per 1000', 'per 1000', 0, 'EQ')
)
SELECT m.goal, m.ord, m.key, m.label, m.unit, m.better,
       CASE r.category WHEN 'MAA' THEN 'FI' ELSE r.code END AS county_code,
       CASE r.category WHEN 'MAA' THEN 'Whole country' ELSE replace(r.name, ' wellbeing services county', '') END AS name,
       raw.year, make_date(raw.year, 1, 1) AS period_start, make_date(raw.year, 12, 31) AS period_end, raw.value
FROM raw
JOIN meta AS m USING (indicator)
JOIN input_24 AS r ON r.sotkanet_id = raw.region AND r.category IN ('HYVINVOINTIALUE', 'MAA')
WHERE raw.value IS NOT NULL

-- Whole country: share who had sufficient time at their last health care visit, per survey year, with the previous survey
SELECT year, period_start, period_end, value AS enough_time_pct, lag(value) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS previous_pct
FROM input_0 WHERE key = 'enough_time' AND county_code = 'FI'

-- Wellbeing services counties where all three screening programmes reach the strategy's 80 % participation, per year with data for all three
WITH s AS (
  SELECT county_code, year, count(*) AS programmes, min(value) AS lowest
  FROM input_0 WHERE key LIKE 'screen_%' AND county_code NOT IN ('FI', '91') GROUP BY county_code, year
)
SELECT year, make_date(year, 1, 1) AS period_start, make_date(year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lowest >= 80) AS counties_all_at_target, count(*) AS counties
FROM s WHERE programmes = 3 GROUP BY year

-- Participation in the three screening programmes per county, latest year of each programme, against the 80 % target
WITH latest AS (SELECT key, max(year) AS year FROM input_0 WHERE key LIKE 'screen_%' GROUP BY key)
SELECT replace(p.label, ' screening participation', '') AS programme, p.name AS county, p.year,
       p.value AS participation_pct, p.value >= 80 AS meets_target,
       min(p.value) OVER (PARTITION BY p.county_code) AS county_lowest
FROM input_0 AS p JOIN latest USING (key, year)
WHERE p.county_code NOT IN ('FI', '91')

-- Cancer deaths in the whole country against the strategy's target of 10% fewer than 13,300 a year
WITH deaths AS (
  SELECT 2022 AS year, deaths_2022 AS deaths FROM input_0
  WHERE county = 'WHOLE COUNTRY' AND cause LIKE '04-21 %'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2023, deaths_2023 FROM input_0 WHERE county = 'WHOLE COUNTRY' AND cause LIKE '04-21 %'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2024, deaths_2024 FROM input_0 WHERE county = 'WHOLE COUNTRY' AND cause LIKE '04-21 %'
)
SELECT
  year,
  make_date(year, 1, 1) AS period_start,
  make_date(year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
  deaths,
  11970 AS target_deaths,
  deaths - 11970 AS above_target
FROM deaths
ORDER BY year

-- Finland against the Nordic level, the average of Sweden and Norway
WITH s AS (
  SELECT
    CASE cancer_code WHEN 160 THEN 'Lung' WHEN 130 THEN 'Pancreas' WHEN 110 THEN 'Liver' END AS cancer,
    CASE sex WHEN 1 THEN 'Men' ELSE 'Women' END AS sex,
    country, period, period_start, period_end, survival
  FROM input_0
)
SELECT
  cancer, sex, period, period_start, period_end,
  max(survival) FILTER (WHERE country = 'Finland') AS finland,
  round(avg(survival) FILTER (WHERE country IN ('Sweden', 'Norway')), 1) AS nordic_level,
  round(avg(survival) FILTER (WHERE country IN ('Sweden', 'Norway'))
    - max(survival) FILTER (WHERE country = 'Finland'), 1) AS gap_pp,
  CASE cancer WHEN 'Pancreas' THEN 6 ELSE 14 END AS strategy_increase_pp
FROM s
GROUP BY cancer, sex, period, period_start, period_end
HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE country IN ('Sweden', 'Norway')) = 2
   AND max(survival) FILTER (WHERE country = 'Finland') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cancer, sex, period_start

-- Latest five-year window: Finland, the Nordic level, the gap and the strategy's 2035 target
SELECT
  cancer, sex, period, period_start, period_end,
  finland AS finland_pct,
  nordic_level AS nordic_level_pct,
  gap_pp,
  strategy_increase_pp,
  finland + strategy_increase_pp AS target_2035_pct
FROM input_0
WHERE period_end = (SELECT max(period_end) FROM input_0)
ORDER BY gap_pp DESC

-- Finland and the Nordic level per cancer and window, men and women averaged, for a chart
SELECT cancer, period_start, period_end, 'Finland' AS series, round(avg(finland), 1) AS survival
FROM input_0 GROUP BY cancer, period_start, period_end HAVING count(*) = 2
UNION ALL
SELECT cancer, period_start, period_end, 'Nordic level (Sweden, Norway)', round(avg(nordic_level), 1)
FROM input_0 GROUP BY cancer, period_start, period_end HAVING count(*) = 2
ORDER BY cancer, series, period_start

-- Days from the pathway's trigger to treatment per county, against the Nordic target for its
-- case mix (synthetic cases). A case's target is its days to treatment less how late its
-- treatment start was against that deadline (negative: early).
WITH c AS (
  SELECT key, county,
    coalesce(days_contact_to_physician, 0) + coalesce(days_physician_to_imaging, 0)
    + coalesce(days_imaging_to_referral, 0) + coalesce(days_referral_to_specialist, 0)
    + coalesce(days_specialist_to_workup, 0) + coalesce(days_workup_to_treatment, 0) AS days_from_contact
  FROM input_1
),
r AS (
  SELECT key, patient_pathway_clock_start AS clock_start, patient_pathway_treatment_start_by AS late
  FROM input_0 WHERE patient_pathway_treatment_start_status IN ('met', 'late')
)
SELECT county, count(*) AS cases,
  median(days_from_contact - clock_start) AS median_days,
  median(days_from_contact - clock_start - late) AS nordic_target_days
FROM r JOIN c USING (key)
GROUP BY county ORDER BY median_days DESC

-- Interventional cancer trials with a site in each country, one row per trial and country, by start year.
-- A multinational trial counts once for every country it has a site in.
WITH t AS (
  SELECT 'Finland' AS country, * FROM input_0 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Sweden', * FROM input_1 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Norway', * FROM input_2 UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Denmark', * FROM input_3
)
SELECT country, nct_id, CAST(left(start_date, 4) AS INTEGER) AS start_year,
       make_date(CAST(left(start_date, 4) AS INTEGER), 1, 1) AS period_start,
       make_date(CAST(left(start_date, 4) AS INTEGER), 12, 31) AS period_end,
       status, sponsor_class = 'INDUSTRY' AS industry_led,
       CAST(phases AS VARCHAR) LIKE '%PHASE1%' AS early_phase
FROM t WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL

-- Finland: new interventional cancer trials per start year, complete years only, with the change on the year before and the strategy's +10 % a year
WITH y AS (
  SELECT start_year, count(*) AS trials FROM input_0
  WHERE country = 'Finland' AND start_year < year(current_date) GROUP BY start_year
)
SELECT start_year AS year, make_date(start_year, 1, 1) AS period_start, make_date(start_year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
       trials, lag(trials) OVER (ORDER BY start_year) AS previous_trials,
       round(100.0 * (trials / lag(trials) OVER (ORDER BY start_year) - 1), 1) AS change_pct,
       10 AS target_change_pct
FROM y

-- Finland's new cancer trials per million inhabitants against the Nordic level (the strategy's mean of Sweden and Norway), per complete start year.
-- Populations: approximate 2024 figures in millions, held constant.
WITH pop(country, million) AS (VALUES ('Finland', 5.60), ('Sweden', 10.55), ('Norway', 5.55)),
pc AS (
  SELECT country, start_year, count(*) / million AS per_million
  FROM input_0 JOIN pop USING (country) WHERE start_year < year(current_date)
  GROUP BY country, start_year, million
)
SELECT start_year AS year, make_date(start_year, 1, 1) AS period_start, make_date(start_year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
       round(max(per_million) FILTER (WHERE country = 'Finland'), 1) AS finland_per_million,
       round(avg(per_million) FILTER (WHERE country IN ('Sweden', 'Norway')), 1) AS nordic_level_per_million
FROM pc GROUP BY start_year

-- Lung cancer pathways (synthetic cases): median days per step against the Nordic standard
-- time of that step, as the patient pathway model compiles the Danish, Norwegian and Swedish
-- standards (work-up to treatment: surgery).
WITH t(step, nordic_days) AS (
  VALUES ('days_contact_to_physician', 7), ('days_physician_to_imaging', 6),
    ('days_imaging_to_referral', 4), ('days_referral_to_specialist', 6),
    ('days_specialist_to_workup', 22), ('days_workup_to_treatment', 14)
),
d AS (
  UNPIVOT (SELECT * FROM input_0 WHERE site = 'lung')
  ON days_contact_to_physician, days_physician_to_imaging, days_imaging_to_referral,
    days_referral_to_specialist, days_specialist_to_workup, days_workup_to_treatment
  INTO NAME step VALUE days
)
SELECT CASE step
    WHEN 'days_contact_to_physician' THEN '1 Contact to physician'
    WHEN 'days_physician_to_imaging' THEN '2 Physician to imaging'
    WHEN 'days_imaging_to_referral' THEN '3 Imaging to referral'
    WHEN 'days_referral_to_specialist' THEN '4 Referral to specialist'
    WHEN 'days_specialist_to_workup' THEN '5 Specialist to work-up'
    ELSE '6 Work-up to treatment' END AS step,
  median(days) AS median_days, any_value(nordic_days) AS nordic_days
FROM d JOIN t USING (step)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

-- Days from the pathway's trigger to treatment by month of first contact, against the
-- Nordic target for that month's case mix (synthetic cases).
WITH c AS (
  SELECT key, date_trunc('month', CAST(first_contact AS DATE)) AS month,
    coalesce(days_contact_to_physician, 0) + coalesce(days_physician_to_imaging, 0)
    + coalesce(days_imaging_to_referral, 0) + coalesce(days_referral_to_specialist, 0)
    + coalesce(days_specialist_to_workup, 0) + coalesce(days_workup_to_treatment, 0) AS days_from_contact
  FROM input_1
),
r AS (
  SELECT key, patient_pathway_clock_start AS clock_start, patient_pathway_treatment_start_by AS late
  FROM input_0 WHERE patient_pathway_treatment_start_status IN ('met', 'late')
)
SELECT month, count(*) AS cases,
  median(days_from_contact - clock_start) AS median_days,
  median(days_from_contact - clock_start - late) AS nordic_target_days
FROM r JOIN c USING (key)
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

-- Coverage: how many of the 22 mainland wellbeing services counties have a value, per indicator and year
SELECT label AS indicator, ord, year, count(*) AS counties
FROM input_0 WHERE county_code NOT IN ('FI', '91') GROUP BY label, ord, year

-- Series-break check: the county median of each indicator against its previous year with data (ratio). Above 1.5 or below 0.67 suggests a definition or unit change.
WITH m AS (
  SELECT key, label, year, median(value) AS med FROM input_0
  WHERE county_code NOT IN ('FI', '91') GROUP BY key, label, year
)
SELECT label AS indicator, year, make_date(year, 1, 1) AS period_start, make_date(year, 12, 31) AS period_end,
       med AS county_median, round(med / lag(med) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY year), 2) AS ratio,
       coalesce(med / lag(med) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY year) NOT BETWEEN 0.67 AND 1.5, false) AS suspected_break
FROM m

-- Profile per indicator over the 22 mainland counties at its latest year: resolution (distinct values), skewness, and IQR outliers (beyond 1.5 IQR) with the counties concerned
WITH latest AS (SELECT key, max(year) AS year FROM input_0 WHERE county_code NOT IN ('FI', '91') GROUP BY key),
v AS (
  SELECT p.key, p.label, p.ord, p.name, p.year, p.value
  FROM input_0 AS p JOIN latest USING (key, year) WHERE p.county_code NOT IN ('FI', '91')
),
q AS (
  SELECT key, quantile_cont(value, 0.25) AS q1, quantile_cont(value, 0.75) AS q3 FROM v GROUP BY key
)
SELECT v.label AS indicator, v.ord, max(v.year) AS year, count(*) AS counties,
       count(DISTINCT v.value) AS distinct_values, round(skewness(v.value), 2) AS skew,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE v.value < q1 - 1.5 * (q3 - q1) OR v.value > q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1)) AS iqr_outliers,
       coalesce(string_agg(v.name, ', ') FILTER (WHERE v.value < q1 - 1.5 * (q3 - q1) OR v.value > q3 + 1.5 * (q3 - q1)), '') AS outlier_counties
FROM v JOIN q USING (key)
GROUP BY v.label, v.ord ORDER BY v.ord

-- Pairwise correlation of county indicators across the 22 mainland wellbeing services counties (Aland and the whole country left out), each indicator at its latest year.
-- r: Pearson, with a 95 % interval from Fisher's z. rho: Spearman, the Pearson r of the ranks.
-- p: two-sided, from Fisher's z (normal approximation; erfc after Abramowitz and Stegun 7.1.26). q: Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p over all pairs.
-- These are ecological correlations between counties, not effects on individuals.
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT key, max(year) AS year FROM input_0 WHERE county_code NOT IN ('FI', '91') GROUP BY key
),
x AS (
  SELECT p.key, p.label, p.ord, p.goal, p.county_code, p.value,
         rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p.key ORDER BY p.value) AS rk
  FROM input_0 AS p JOIN latest USING (key, year)
  WHERE p.county_code NOT IN ('FI', '91')
    AND p.key NOT IN ('oncology_visits', 'smokers_low_edu', 'smokers_high_edu', 'discrim_high_edu')
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT a.key AS key_a, a.label AS label_a, a.ord AS ord_a, a.goal AS goal_a,
         b.key AS key_b, b.label AS label_b, b.ord AS ord_b, b.goal AS goal_b,
         count(*) AS n, corr(a.value, b.value) AS r, corr(a.rk, b.rk) AS rho
  FROM x AS a JOIN x AS b ON a.county_code = b.county_code AND a.ord < b.ord
  GROUP BY ALL
  HAVING count(*) >= 10
),
z AS (
  SELECT *, 0.5 * ln((1 + r) / (1 - r)) AS fz, 1 / sqrt(n - 3) AS se FROM pairs
),
t AS (
  SELECT *, abs(fz) / se / sqrt(2) AS u, 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * abs(fz) / se / sqrt(2)) AS tt FROM z
),
pv AS (
  SELECT *, (0.254829592 * tt - 0.284496736 * pow(tt, 2) + 1.421413741 * pow(tt, 3)
             - 1.453152027 * pow(tt, 4) + 1.061405429 * pow(tt, 5)) * exp(-u * u) AS p_value
  FROM t
),
bh AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY p_value) AS i, count(*) OVER () AS m FROM pv
)
SELECT key_a, label_a, ord_a, goal_a, key_b, label_b, ord_b, goal_b, n,
       round(r, 3) AS r, round(rho, 3) AS rho,
       round(tanh(fz - 1.96 * se), 3) AS r_lower, round(tanh(fz + 1.96 * se), 3) AS r_upper,
       p_value,
       least(1, min(p_value * m / i) OVER (ORDER BY p_value DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS q_value,
       abs(r) AS strength,
       CASE WHEN r >= 0 THEN 'positive' ELSE 'negative' END AS direction
FROM bh

-- Every pair where Pearson r and Spearman rho disagree by more than 0.2: the linear correlation leans on a few counties, so rho is the safer reading
SELECT label_a || ' × ' || label_b AS pair, r, rho, round(abs(r - rho), 2) AS divergence
FROM input_0 WHERE abs(r - rho) > 0.2 ORDER BY abs(r - rho) DESC
